bonuses.footnote: Regularity adds to your weekly total but does not chip at the boss: it rewards turning up, not output. The squad bonus multiplies a challenge's damage for everyone who cleared it, including those who got there first.
bonuses.regularityLabel: Regularity · days played in the week
bonuses.teamLabel: Squad · multiplier on the challenge's damage
bonuses.title: Regularity & squad

categories.ELITE: Around 125% of a usual week. Without a big collective week, it survives.
categories.MINOR: Around 80% of the squad's usual week. Usually folded by midweek.
categories.STANDARD: Exactly the squad's usual week. Everyone has to pitch in.

boss.description: Every week a boss shows up with a health pool shared by the whole squad. That pool is not a fixed number: it is computed from what the squad actually produced over the recent closed weeks, multiplied by the number of active players. An active player who does not play therefore makes the boss heavier without draining it. Bring it down before Sunday night. The campaign itself only runs for the act in progress: it starts over on a new act, without erasing the fights already won.
boss.title: One boss, one shared health bar

calibration.bounds: The reference cannot run away: it stays bounded, so a full stop never makes the boss fall to a single match and a surge never makes it unreachable.
calibration.description: Difficulty is never set by hand: the boss's bar tracks the median of what the squad actually produced over the last 4 closed weeks. Play more and the boss grows, ease off and it shrinks. A one-off marathon week does not count, the median ignores it.
calibration.title: Difficulty that tunes itself

challenges.description: Every Monday, five challenges are drawn from the catalogue, one per difficulty tier. The higher the tier, the more damage it deals to the boss. A challenge does not come back until its whole tier has been cycled through.
challenges.title: Five challenges, one per difficulty

damage.description: The mode and outcome of a match set the damage it deals. A ranked win counts for the most, but every match played, won or not, adds to the week.
damage.title: Every match throws a punch
damage.decayLabel: Daily returns · match rank within the day
damage.decayFootnote: Past the fifth match of a day, a match is worth less. A day's matches are ranked from the most to the least rewarding, never in the order you played them, so warming up can never cost your ranked games. Spreading over several days beats doing it all at once.

eligibility.description: One rule, everywhere: a match counts if it was played in a mode the tracker follows, if it played at least one round, if you scored in it, and if it was not a remake. A remake, an abandoned match or an unrecognized queue deals no damage, counts as no active day, and progresses no challenge. It still shows in your history: it was played, it simply does not count towards the week.
eligibility.title: What counts as a played match

progression.description: Some challenges ask not for an absolute threshold but for progress on yourself: beating your own K/D, ACS or headshot rate from the previous 4 weeks by a given percentage. Grinding matches at the same level does not complete them, since the measure is a rate. With no history over the last 4 weeks, the challenge stays out of reach.
progression.title: Progression challenges

ranking.description: Total damage for the week decides the ranking. The rest is glory.

facts.championTitle: 1st place in a finalized week = Champion title, shown on the overview.
facts.crown: The crown stays with the Champion until the next week is finalized.
facts.damage: Weekly ranking: the sum of your damage (matches + challenges + bonuses).
facts.finishingBlow: The finishing blow on the boss is credited separately, in the fight history.

ranking.title: Ranking & crown

boss.body: Every week, an opponent appears with a pool of hit points shared by the whole group. Every match you play and every challenge you clear deals damage to it. It has to fall before Sunday 11:59 pm: miss that, and it survives and the territory stays in its hands.
boss.title: An opponent to defeat

challenges.body: Every Monday, five challenges are drawn at random, from the easiest to the hardest. The harder a challenge is to clear, the more damage it deals to the opponent.
challenges.title: Five challenges to clear every week

intro.body:
You are joining a squad. Every week, the matches you play on Valorant move the whole group forward: they clear challenges, deal damage and push back the enemy holding the territory.

Let's walk through a week.
intro.title: A shared adventure, week after week

players.body: It is all yours to explore, starting now. And who knows: the next champion of this adventure might just be you.
players.title: Every adventurer has a story of their own

ranking.body: Everyone's damage adds up into a weekly ranking. Showing up regularly and clearing challenges together earn bonuses on top. Whoever leads when the week closes takes the Champion title.
ranking.title: Who hits hardest
